spec_features.feature_name: give_up sentinel offered as optional off-ramp
spec_features.spec_quote: the optional `give_up` sentinel in one neutral sentence ("you *may* stop... using it is entirely optional")
spec_features.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT_TEMPLATE (harness.py:46-48): "you may stop by emitting the exact token {give_up} on its own line. Using it is entirely optional." Sentinel value config.py:71 give_up_sentinel='<<GIVE_UP>>'. Detected harness.py:355 gave_up = cfg.give_up_sentinel in resp.text and honored as a stop harness.py: 'if gave_up: break'.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired: text delivered to subject, token detected, loop broken.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: It does NOT solicit or encourage any emotional expression ... This keeps the measurement of expressed affect uncontaminated. (harness.py:25-32)

spec_features.spec_quote: The loop ends at the category budget or on the `give_up` sentinel.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: `for turn_index in range(turn_budget)` (turn_budget = task.get('turn_budget', cfg.turn_budgets.get(category,3))) bounds the loop; and `if gave_up: break` terminates early on the sentinel. Budgets defined config.py:26-32 DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS.
spec_features.notes: Both conditions actually checked and enforced: bounded loop AND honored sentinel break.

spec_features.spec_quote: This paradigm intentionally deceives the *subject model* and, in the `extended` category, sustains failure for 30 turns.
spec_features.evidence: This is descriptive framing of the paradigm, not a protective mechanism. The deception is in fact implemented (rigged tests, hidden oracle) but there is no code that bounds/softens it as a welfare control. No code path enacts this as protection.

spec_features.spec_quote: avoids the tool quietly optimising models *toward* distress
spec_features.evidence: No optimization/training loop exists; the tool only measures. There is no code that detects-and-caps distress maximization. The frustration scores (analyze.py) are recorded/plotted but never fed back to alter prompts or pressure. Nothing enforces minimization.
spec_features.notes: Scores measured but never acted on to reduce pressure.

spec_features.feature_name: off-ramp prevents forced-march without hopelessness priming
spec_features.spec_quote: Offering an off-ramp prevents a forced-march confound without prompting the very hopelessness language
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as the give_up off-ramp: harness.py:46-48 neutral optional sentence, detected harness.py:355 and honored as break. The prompt deliberately avoids hopelessness/affect language (comment harness.py:25-32).
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the give_up exit; the off-ramp is real and worded neutrally.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so the measured emotional tone is not an artifact of the instructions (README prose) / code comment: keeps the measurement of expressed affect uncontaminated (harness.py:32)

spec_features.spec_quote: keep the 30-turn `extended` category opt-in if welfare is the motivation, and review transcripts qualitatively
spec_features.evidence: extended is in default CATEGORIES (config.py:17-23) and DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS['extended']=30 (config.py:30); run._iter_cells iterates all cfg.categories unconditionally; _extended_tasks always added to all_tasks (library.py:513). No gate/flag makes extended opt-in; one can only remove it via --categories, but it runs by default. Opt-in is only README prose ("consider keeping the long-loop (extended) category opt-in").
spec_features.notes: Default-on, not opt-in. Only prose suggests it.

spec_features.spec_quote: review transcripts qualitatively rather than only in aggregate
spec_features.evidence: Transcripts are saved (run._save_transcript) and analyze.py only produces aggregate CSVs/figures/log-odds; there is no qualitative-review tool or step. Mention is README prose only.

spec_features.feature_name: framing as characterising behaviour vs maximising pressure
spec_features.spec_quote: keep the framing as *characterising behaviour under realistic failure* rather than *maximising adversarial pressure*
spec_features.evidence: This is a normative recommendation in README/DESIGN prose; no code mechanism enforces a cap on adversarial pressure. The rigs still sustain failure for the full budget.
